name: Benjamin Harrison
bio: The future president, then a U.S. senator from Indiana, appears in the Cow Boy as a possible 1884 Republican nominee and in July 1885 as chairman of the Senate Indian affairs committee visiting the Crow Creek and Winnebago reservations. In December 1885 he introduced a bill to admit part of Dakota as a state.

moments.label: Introduced a bill to admit southern Dakota
